Initial release of anima-identity: gives agents their own real-world digital identities.

- Provides agents with a real email address, US phone number (SMS-capable), voice calling, and an encrypted credential vault.
- Step-by-step sign-up flow: sign up, receive credentials, verify identity via OTP, and unlock full capabilities.
- Free tier available with no credit card required.
- API endpoints to manage identity, email, phone/SMS, voice, and vault.
- Human verification and organization management through web console.
